crossOperatorDuplicateAudit.method: All saved retained photos compared using256bit average hashes; candidate pairs at distance<=8 then128px normalizedRGB pixel RMS. Names/building addresses alone do not merge properties.
crossOperatorDuplicateAudit.conclusion: No cross-operator duplicate established in the saved FQ/Heirloom evidence. No shared asset URL or near-identical image match found among187 retained MassLiving and252 other photos. Building/neighborhood/style similarities are not treated as duplicate proof. MassLiving rental entrances remain undisclosed, so street comparison is incomplete.
